decisions.rationale: Lean-to plank shed, 4 x 5 m, eaves 3.2 m rising to 4.2 m (raised from 2.9 m so nothing below 3 m leaves the collider); 212 triangles.

Placed along roads in every settlement and inn at gameplay cameras (18-40 m): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier (doors 1.3 x 2.8 m, the soldier clears a door by 0.55 m); walls stay inside the oriented-box collider, eaves overhang at most 0.78 m; the architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it.
